description: French display titles for paintings whose catalog title was not in French. Changes are applied by the app from app/src/main/assets/titles-fr.json. Sources: wikidata-fr-label = French label of the matched Wikidata item; wikidata-P1476-fr = its P1476 title in French; '-verified' = candidate match checked by hand; manual-* = translation/correction judged manually (see note). Matches come from Commons file structured data (P6243/P180/Artwork template), WikiArt ID (P6002), or title + creator (P170) search.
